_comment: First-party Farmer's Delight WILD-RICE compat on the AQUATIC family (FARMERSDELIGHTPLAN #16). Rivers and swamps are FD's canonical wild-rice biomes, so wild_rice is added to the aquatic freshwater pond (top-level) AND the #is_river / swamp band ponds. 'pond' is a scalar-REPLACE (top-level) and a band pond replaces per matched band, so each pond here is a VERBATIM copy of aquatic.json's pond with wild_rice appended to plants — re-sync if a base pond changes. The river/swamp bands carry only {biomes, pond} so the merge keeps the base band's surface/mobs/variants and swaps just the pond. PondCarver.plantInPond stands wild_rice at the water surface. Inert without FD (placePondPlants gates on Lookup.hasBlock → byte-identical). IDS VERIFIED vs FarmersDelight-1.21.1-1.3.2.jar (2026-07-03).
